title: Decoder Skill Graph v1 — Chunk Racer Slice
description: Directed acyclic graph of reading micro-skills for the Chunk Racer flagship. Nodes carry prerequisites, mastery thresholds, and app mappings.

nodes.name: Phonemic Awareness
nodes.description: Hear and manipulate individual sounds in spoken words

nodes.name: Letter–Sound Correspondence
nodes.description: Map printed letters to their most common sounds

nodes.name: Blend Onset + Rime
nodes.description: Combine beginning sound with word-family ending

nodes.name: Decode CVC Words
nodes.description: Sound out and blend short vowel consonant-vowel-consonant words

nodes.name: Decode Digraphs & Blends
nodes.description: Read words with consonant blends and digraphs

nodes.name: Multisyllable Chunking
nodes.description: Break longer words into syllable chunks

nodes.name: Read Connected Decodable Text
nodes.description: Read short, controlled decodable sentences accurately BEFORE pushing recognition speed — the decoding→fluency bridge (D21, adopts Dr. Vance). Guards against training context-guessing over decoding.

nodes.name: Fluency at Target WPM
nodes.description: Read connected chunks with speed and accuracy

tracks.name: Executive Function Track
tracks.description: Parallel skills surfaced by Focus Dojo and woven into every session
